虽然如此，但是让爻雪将异能觉醒药剂的价格降下来也是绝对不可能的。

这样做不但会给其他客人留下不好的印象，就连第一个觉醒异能的苏辰也会对她心生不满，以后她若是再拿出什么高价值的物品，这些人怕是也不会争先恐后地购买了，毕竟万一自己前脚买了，东西后脚就降价了怎么办呢。

爻雪一屁股坐在身后的摇椅上，在脑海中思索着解决办法。

现在异能觉醒药剂的定价是一瓶一百枚晶核，但实际上她制作一瓶异能觉醒药剂只需要三十枚晶核，也就是说，一百枚晶核可以制作三瓶异能觉醒药剂还多余出十枚。

其中一瓶给卖家，剩下的两瓶她完全可以赊出去。

并不是什么都不给的那种赊，而是缴纳一部分定金，就跟买房子一样，交了首付之后房子就是你的了，但之后每个月还需要还房贷。

爻雪觉得这个办法十分不错，但为了避免一些人实在还不起，然后逃跑的事情发生，她决定就不要利息了，至于首付，那就定价三十枚晶核好了，毕竟她现在手里的晶核其实并不多。

加起来总共也就只有三百枚出头而已。

之前游戏商店升级是她白嫖了系统的，所以没有消耗晶核，但她总不可能每次都白嫖系统，还是需要自己努力才行。

“差点把这件事给忘了。”

似乎是想到了什么，爻雪猛地从躺椅上站起身，然后一边查看游戏商店下次升级所需要达到的条件，一边开始准备发布新的任务。

根据之前的经验，游戏商店想要升级，应该是需要从秘境里面获取材料才行吧。

【游戏商店二级升级三级条件如下：

一级晶核一千枚，干净的淡水一百吨，石头一百吨，树木一千棵，绿植一千棵，员工十名，卖出亲手制作的商品一百件，商店入住率达到百分之十。】

Even so, it is absolutely impossible for Yaoxue to lower the price of the power awakening potion.

Not only would this leave a bad impression on other guests, but even Su Chen, who was the first to awaken her powers, would be dissatisfied with her. If she brings out any high-value items in the future, these people may not rush to buy them. After all, what if she buys something first and then the price of the item is reduced.

Yaoxue sat down on the rocking chair behind her, thinking about a solution in her mind.

The current price of the power awakening potion is one hundred crystal cores per bottle, but in fact she only needs thirty crystal cores to make one bottle of power awakening potion. In other words, one hundred crystal cores can make three bottles of the power awakening potion and there are still ten more.

One bottle is given to the seller, and she can give the remaining two bottles on credit.

It's not like giving nothing on credit, but paying a part of the deposit, just like buying a house. After you pay the down payment, the house is yours, but you still need to pay off the mortgage every month.

Yaoxue thought this method was very good, but in order to prevent some people from running away because they couldn't afford the repayment, she decided not to ask for interest. As for the down payment, she would set the price at 30 crystal cores. After all, she didn't actually have many crystal cores in her hand now.

The total total is only a little over three hundred pieces.

She used to upgrade the system in the game store for free, so she did not consume crystal cores. However, she could not use the system for free every time. She still needed to work hard on her own.

"I almost forgot about it."

As if she had thought of something, Yaoxue suddenly stood up from the recliner, and then started to prepare to release a new mission while checking the conditions required for the next upgrade in the game store.

Based on previous experience, if you want to upgrade in the game store, you should obtain materials from the secret realm.

[The conditions for upgrading the game store to level 2 and level 3 are as follows:

One thousand first-class crystal nuclei, one hundred tons of clean fresh water, one hundred tons of stone, one thousand trees, one thousand green plants, ten employees, one hundred hand-made products sold, and the store occupancy rate reached 10%.】
